sources.title: Ford Media - 2022 Mustang Mach-E Technical Specifications (PDF)
sources.notes: Usable capacity SR 70 / ER 91 kWh; DC up to 115 kW (SR) and 150 kW (ER, CA1, GT); cells SR 288 / ER 376.

sources.title: Ford Media - 2023 Mustang Mach-E Technical Specifications (PDF)
sources.notes: Usable SR 72 kWh (108 cells) / ER 91 kWh (376 cells); up to 150 kW DC on every trim.

sources.title: Ford Media - 2025 Mustang Mach-E Technical Specifications (PDF)
sources.notes: Usable SR 73 kWh (108 cells), ER 88 kWh (360 cells), GT 91 kWh (376 cells); up to 150 kW DC; Fast Charging Adapter (NACS) optional.

sources.title: Ford Media - 2023 F-150 Lightning Technical Specifications (PDF)
sources.notes: Usable 98 / 131 kWh; onboard charger 11.3 kW (SR) and 19.2 kW (ER) input; 150 kW DC; lithium-ion pouch; 15-80% 44 / 41 min.

sources.title: Ford Media - 2025 F-150 Lightning Technical Specifications (PDF)
sources.notes: Usable 98 / 123 / 131 kWh; onboard charger 11.3 kW (19.2 kW fleet-only option on 131); 150 kW+ DC; 15-80% 32 / 38 / 38 min.

sources.title: InsideEVs - 2022 Ford Mustang Mach-E gets more range (usable capacity change)
sources.notes: SR 68 to 70 kWh and ER 88 to 91 kWh usable; totals 75.7 and 98.8 kWh. Relays Ford figures.

sources.title: InsideEVs - LFP-powered 2023 Mach-E vs outgoing SR
sources.notes: LFP SR 72 kWh, 150 kW, 10-80% 33 min; NCM SR 70 kWh, 115 kW, 38 min; ER 91 kWh NCM 150 kW 45 min. Relays Ford figures.

sources.title: InsideEVs - 2024 Mach-E EPA range
sources.notes: 2024: SR RWD and AWD LFP 72 kWh; ER, GT, Rally 91 kWh.

sources.title: Electrek - Ford announces $3.5B Michigan LFP battery factory with CATL
sources.notes: Mach-E LFP pack reads 78.21 kWh on 225 Ah at 347.8 V (gross).

sources.title: Wikipedia - Ford Mustang Mach-E
sources.notes: Packs NMC (LGES) and LFP (CATL from MY2023); onboard AC 11 kW; 2025 US car has native CCS1 port.

sources.title: AutoTrader.ca - Ford says Mustang Mach-E charging times are 30% faster now
sources.notes: Ford claims 10-80% about 38 min (standard battery) and 45 min (extended range), 2021 model.

sources.title: Ford Canada - How do I precondition my battery for DC Fast Charging?
sources.notes: Preconditioning is triggered by planning a route or choosing a DC fast charger in Connected Navigation / Google Maps / Apple Maps EV Routing; no manual switch described; says Ford electric vehicles include En-Route Preconditioning; Apple Maps only on 2026 Mach-E.

sources.title: Ford - Mustang Mach-E charging (EV expertise)
sources.notes: With available Connected Navigation you can precondition the battery on the way to the charger.

sources.title: Ford Canada/US From the Road - Ford customers can now charge on Tesla Superchargers in the U.S. and Canada
sources.notes: F-150 Lightning and Mustang Mach-E customers get Supercharger access in the U.S. and Canada; adapter required; reservations from 29 Feb 2024. Press reports say 2021-2024 model years eligible.

sources.title: Ford Canada - Connected Navigation EV Routing
sources.notes: Connected Navigation triggers automatic preconditioning near a DC fast charger; 2025 Mach-E and F-150 Lightning have the Supercharger feature from the factory, earlier years via software updates.

sources.title: InsideEVs - Mach-E can now precondition its battery via CarPlay
sources.notes: Mach-E has a CCS1 port; no manual preconditioning control described; automatic on route planning.

sources.title: Battery Design - 2022 Ford F-150 Lightning ER pack
sources.notes: ER pack: NCM9 SK On cells, 349 V nominal, 408 Ah, 142 kWh total. Page notes limited data.

sources.title: Ford Corporate - Ford commits to manufacturing batteries (SK Innovation NCM, F-150 Lightning)
sources.notes: SK Innovation high-nickel NCM cell mass produced in the U.S. for the F-150 Lightning.

battery.capacity_usable_kwh.notes: 2021 launch usable 68 kWh (SR), changed to 70 kWh in 2022 (InsideEVs, relays Ford).

battery.chemistry.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia lists NMC packs (LG Energy Solution) for the launch-era Standard and Extended Range.

battery.nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Mach-E LFP pack reads 347.8 V nominal (Electrek); the NMC packs share the same architecture, so 400 V class. Class inferred from the figure.

battery.preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Ford Canada says its electric vehicles use navigation-triggered battery preconditioning (route planning or choosing a DC fast charger in Connected Navigation, Google Maps or Apple Maps EV Routing). The cited page is silent on any manual control and on model years; I found no manual battery-preconditioning control documented in Ford support pages or owner forums (owners have asked for one since 2021), so automatic_with_navigation is the best fit, not a proven fact. Cars from 2021 and 2022 may predate the navigation trigger (the Ford Canada navigation page says earlier model years received it by software update), so the value for this model year is unconfirmed.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: the 2022 Ford spec sheet lists up to 115 kW for this pack and Wikipedia lists the same 115 / 150 kW for 2020-22, but the basis is unproven: InsideEVs (2022) says Ford "improved the fast charging curve" for 2022, so the 2021 peak may differ.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia infobox lists 11 kW onboard AC for the Mach-E (Ford owners cite 10.5 kW output / 11.3-11.5 kW at 48 A); no onboard-charger change found 2021-2026. Wikipedia does not name a market, so the Canadian car is unproven.
